test_unscoped_enum: test pybind11 unscoped enum bindings for name, value, members, comparison, and arithmetic operators
test_scoped_enum: test pybind11 scoped enum bindings for ordering and type-safe comparison behavior
test_binary_operators: test pybind11 enum binary operators including bitwise OR, AND, XOR, and NOT on flags
test_enum_to_int: test pybind11 enum implicit conversion to int, uint, and long long types
test_char_underlying_enum: test pybind11 enum with char underlying type for hashing, construction, and state
